steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Verify that an RFQ template is applied before interacting with the sheet.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ product sheet, add/select the product CYLINDER, choose CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB, verify Product Variant fills as Default Variant, enter Quantity Requested as 10, choose Plant Name (LOC-0001) for Delivery location, click Details on the row, and verify the product details open showing code, variant, specification, and attachments as read-only.
